author: 35Christmass
quote: I bought this game and asked immediately a refund. The first missions are a pure shame : nothing interesting. In GTA 5 the first missions where impressive filled with action. Second, the graphics. 30 fps ? Like wtf !!! This is like the most revolting thing, everything seems slow, junky, heavy. Like it's just unplayable. I really hate the persona of Jason and Lucia. Jason is washed out, no personality, like there is a serious contrast with San Andreas, IV and 5. How can you go down so low? I ask for a refund. And if they don't refund, I will report to my bank. Unacceptable.
